The Kehlet Mansion has seven bedrooms, five full beds, two queen beds, one twin size bed and a rollaway bed. It also has 3 bathrooms, with a bathtub/shower in one and shower stalls in the others. Also part of the Mansion area is an outdoor paved area , available for weddings and other group events. 

Enjoy the sunrise from the platform deck on the rocks, prepare your summer meals on the large propane Bar-B-Que grills, and soak in the beauty of Lake Tahoe through large bay windows and sun deck. The Kelhet Mansion offers excellent accomodations for large families and events, including a formal dining table which seats eight, exterior bar shack for serving event guests on the ample paved area, and a semi-private beach.
No pets are allowed.
NO PETS ALLOWED.
The Washoe House is rented with a studio cabin.
There is a twin bedroom, two queen bedrooms in the main house with one double futon and a double bed in the studio cabin.
The main house has a full kitchen and full bathroom and the studio has a studio bathroom.
There is an enclosed porch for the dining area and you can enjoy the view of Lake Tahoe from its large windows.
It has its own picnic area and secluded parking.

RV sites in the sholder season are $65 per night. In the peak season the rate is $75 per night. The billing on Recreation.gov is different--When making your reservation more than 30 days ahead of your stay, you will be billed for 50% at the time of reservation and then the other 50% before the 30 day deadline. Recreation.gov will send two reminder emails.
